ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent court wins and ongoing investigations into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and explore the impact on the state's healthcare system
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: I believe this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting the healthcare system. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we may be able to identify key players and patterns of fraud.
